banglaExplanation: Self evaluation সবচেয়ে সহজ আর কার্যকর উপায় নিজের training উন্নত করার।
নিয়মিত reflect করুন: tangible (learner performance, feedback) আর intangible (gut reaction)।
Negative comments-এ রাগ করবেন না; ওগুলোই improvement দেখায়।
Evaluation-এর পরে results analyse করে ঠিক করুন পরের বার কী বদলাবেন।

example.bn: সেশনের পরে IT trainer self evaluation ফর্ম পূরণ করে দেখেন practice সময় কম ছিল।
example.en: After a session, an IT trainer fills in a self evaluation form. She notes she gave little practice time.

short.modelAnswer:
Self evaluation is one of the most productive exercises to improve your teaching/training performance. It is also one of the easiest to implement.
1. Reflect on your teaching on a regular basis.
2. Look for tangible elements: learner performance and feedback.
3. Look for intangible elements: your 'gut reaction' to the session.

realQuestions.answer:
Self evaluation is one of the most productive exercises that you can use to improve
your teaching/training performance. It is also one of the easiest to implement. You
need to reflect on your teaching on a regular basis. You will be looking for tangible
elements (such as learner performance and feedback) and intangible elements (like
your 'gut reaction' to the session - did you feel good about it).
